title: Personal Website Redesign
tagline: Modern developer portfolio built with React + TypeScript
description: A complete redesign of my personal developer portfolio focused on performance, scalability, and clean UI architecture. Built using React, TypeScript, and Vite, with a component-driven structure and reusable component design.

title: Oxygen Bookings
description: A class reservation platform built with React, TypeScript, and Appwrite. The system includes secure authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), automated email notifications, and an administrative dashboard for managing bookings and users.

title: Allergens Prediction Models
tagline: Evaluating protein encoding schemes for allergenicity prediction
description: Master’s thesis project exploring how different protein encoding strategies impact the performance of convolutional neural networks in predicting allergenic proteins. The study compares integer encoding, hydrophobicity encoding and embeddings from protein language models, achieving state-of-the-art performance with ESM-2 embeddings.

title: Computer Vision Algorithms
description: A collection of three computer vision mini-projects developed for a master’s level Computer Vision module. The projects showcase classical corner detection and image stitching, image segmentation techniques, and sparse 3D reconstruction from stereo image pairs.
features: Image segmentation using clustering and graph-based methods

title: Connect Four Game (Course Project)
tagline: Console-based Connect Four with Minimax algorithm
description: A console-based implementation of the classic Connect Four game in Java, developed for a master’s level course. The game features two-player, zero-sum logic and uses the Minimax algorithm to model game decision logic, with plans for GUI support in future iterations.
features: Minimax algorithm for game decision logic
Modular Java classes representing game components

title: GeoScavenger
description: GeoScavenger is a mobile and web platform that enables interactive treasure hunt experiences. Players can join hunts, track their progress on an interactive map, follow clues, and communicate with organizers in real time. The system also includes built-in emergency support for player safety. Hunt organizers use the companion web dashboard to create and manage hunts, monitor player locations, and communicate instantly with participants.
features: Mobile app with player authentication and profile management
Interactive map with treasure hunt clues and activities
Instant messaging between players and organizers
Emergency help button with location sharing
Web dashboard for creating and managing hunts
Real-time player tracking on the map

title: BookHood
description: BookHood is a user-friendly online platform for book lovers to discover and organize their reading journey. Users can explore books filtered by genre, rating, or recent additions, add ratings and reviews, manage personal reading lists, and find the nearest bookstore using map integration.
features: Book discovery with filtering by genre, rating, and time added
Display of key book details (cover, author, summary, ISBN, etc.)
Personal reading lists: Want to Read, Reading, Completed
Nearest bookstore lookup with map integration
